title: Slipping to the Extreme: A Mixed Method to Explain How Extreme Opinions Infiltrate Online Discussions
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodology for analyzing extremist opinions in online discourse using machine learning. While the analysis identifies various opinions related to religion (e.g., Islamophobia, antisemitism) or ethical concerns as categories of problematic speech, the study itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as defined in the instructions.
